brand_identity.name: TableWise
brand_identity.tagline: The Mint-Clean Operating System for Modern Restaurants
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Clean, premium, effortless, trustworthy, and culinary-forward

key_features: Instant Lead Capture with WhatsApp & Email Integration

image_urls.description: Clean restaurant analytics and dashboard UI

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning SaaS marketing website for TableWise. Use React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Shadcn UI components. Ensure soft mint-green accents (#10B981 / #F0FDF4), white surfaces, rounded controls, and crisp bento grids. Include interactive ROI calculator, feature showcase, live demo modal, and a fully functional lead capture form that simulates sending instant WhatsApp and Email notifications to the sales team with success toasts using sonner. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black or pure white without tint
Ensure high contrast on hover states
Include data-testid on all interactive elements
Glassmorphism for sticky navigation with backdrop blur
